page: Microsoft Azure D4nds_v6 is a network-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Dndv6 server family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and an Intel processor, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For storage, the D4nds_v6 instance includes a bundled 236 GB local NVMe SSD. It is also premium storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The server does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This hardware profile is designed for general-purpose workloads, network-optimized tasks, and database applications requiring fast local temporary storage. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a balanced resource density, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require specialized GPU acceleration but benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and local NVMe performance.
